scope:
Prepare fresh-PSS, matched-offset numerical checks of the 2x local chain.

This is a numerical screen, not an integrated-jitter measurement. The point
491.99 MHz deliberately avoids the exact third harmonic of the 164 MHz PSS.

cases.pss: pss pss fund=164M harms=383 tstab=300n maxstep=1p method=traponly errpreset=conservative maxperiods=30 saveinit=no writefinal="__FINAL_STATE__" writepss="__PERIODIC_STATE__"
cases.pnoise: pn pnoise values=[10k 100k 1M 10M 100M 491.99M] pnoisemethod=fullspectrum noisetype=sampled measurement=[edge] sampleratio=6 maxsideband=383

cases.pss: pss pss fund=164M harms=767 tstab=300n maxstep=0.5p maxacfreq=504G method=traponly errpreset=conservative maxperiods=30 saveinit=no writefinal="__FINAL_STATE__" writepss="__PERIODIC_STATE__"
cases.pnoise: pn pnoise values=[10k 100k 1M 10M 100M 491.99M] pnoisemethod=fullspectrum noisetype=sampled measurement=[edge] sampleratio=6 maxsideband=767

condition: TT27/1.2V/984MHz/10fF, noiseless measured RF replay; all device noise; fresh PSS in both cases.
limitation: Combined step/sideband/maxacfreq screen. A failure needs individual-parameter diagnosis; six points do not establish a full-band RMS value.
